metadata.description: Local-first accounting and tax skills for AI agents — statement extraction, bank reconciliation, tax return review, variance analysis, and journal entry testing

plugins.name: cpa-skills
plugins.description: Five skills for accountants, tax professionals, and CPAs: convert PDF bank statements to Excel with a completeness proof, reconcile bank statements to the general ledger, review tax returns against a checklist with evidence for every item tested, run year-over-year variance analysis with enforced explanation quality, and scan a full journal entry population for anomalies. Every skill runs entirely on the local machine and refuses to deliver a workpaper that does not tie.
